acceptanceCriteria: docs/TASKS-EXTERNAL-AGENTS.md states the --line / --refresh cache behaviour and cites TQD-V0-012.
body: TQD-V0-012 already specifies that `doctor --line` reads only the `--refresh` cache; the operator guide docs/TASKS-EXTERNAL-AGENTS.md does not say so, which GitHub beamfall/corvint#791 asked about.
title: docs: state in TASKS-EXTERNAL-AGENTS.md that `doctor --line` reads only the --refresh cache and never scans (GH #791 follow-up)
